2607.24586.title: D-Score: A Spectral Hidden-State Signal for Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models
2607.24586.paper_summary: Large Language Models can produce fluent text that is false, unsupported by the available evidence, or inconsistent with information that appears to be internally represented by the model. We study hallucination detection from the geometry of hidden activations and introduce the D-Score, a simple spectral statistic computed from a single forward pass. For a fixed model, layer, and tolerance parameter, the D-Score counts how many singular directions of the hidden activation matrix have singular values that remain close to the leading one. We use this quantity as a hallucination score, classifying an input text as hallucinated when its D-Score is larger than a pre-defined quantity. The motivation is that, when a model processes a text that conflicts with information available in its own internal state, the hidden representation may encode both the asserted content and some form of counter-evidence, uncertainty, correction, or lack of support; this can make the hidden trajectory spread across additional singular directions. We formalize this intuition through a lightweight spectral argument and evaluate the resulting detector on FAVA-Annotation and RAGTruth. The experiments indicate that the D-Score is a strong hidden-state signal for hallucination detection, while requiring no external verifier, no retrieval step, and no multiple generations.
2607.24586.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型可以生成流暢的文本，但這些文本可能是錯誤的、沒有可用證據支持的，或與模型內部表示的信息不一致。我們從隱藏激活的幾何形狀研究幻覺檢測，並引入 D-Score，這是一種從單次前向傳遞計算出的簡單光譜統計量。對於固定的模型、層和容忍參數，D-Score 計算隱藏激活矩陣中有多少個奇異方向的奇異值保持接近於最大的那一個。我們將這個數量用作幻覺分數，當其 D-Score 大於預定的數量時，將輸入文本分類為幻覺。其動機在於，當模型處理與其自身內部狀態中可用信息相矛盾的文本時，隱藏表示可能同時編碼所聲稱的內容和某種形式的反證據、不確定性、修正或缺乏支持；這可能使隱藏軌跡在額外的奇異方向上擴展。我們通過輕量級的光譜論證形式化這一直覺，並在 FAVA-Annotation 和 RAGTruth 上評估結果檢測器。實驗表明，D-Score 是一個強大的隱藏狀態信號，用於幻覺檢測，同時不需要外部驗證者、檢索步驟和多次生成。
